name: IXXAT VCI4 Driver
notes: USB-to-CAN V2 and FD share vcinpl2.dll. Enumerate returns one entry per VCI device; channel is selected at connect. FD capability is read from CAN_FEATURE_EXTDATA / FASTDATA.
